findings.summary: Baseline Jest discovery includes stale Stryker sandbox copies.
findings.evidence: pnpm run test:weak found 2 suites and 2 tests; test:strong found 2 suites and 4 tests. Jest reported a package naming collision between fixture/package.json and .stryker-tmp/sandbox-ig7Z6b/package.json.
findings.impact: An interrupted mutation run leaves stale source/test copies in the discovery tree; reruns can execute extra tests and no longer describe only the intended fixture.
findings.requested_change: Anchor testMatch to <rootDir>/tests/<suite>.test.js and exclude temporary sandbox metadata from discovery. Recheck both baselines and mutations, then refresh configuration hashes and retained evidence.
findings.resolution: Root-anchored Jest globs and temporary-directory exclusion eliminate stale sandbox discovery. Independent baselines now run exactly one suite with 1 weak/2 strong tests. Refreshed mutation reports and current configuration hashes match; weak=5 Killed+1 Survived, strong=6 Killed.

findings.summary: RESTler report path disagrees with the cited release documentation.
findings.evidence: v9.3.1 Program.fs sets taskWorkingDirectory from args.task.ToString(); Types.fs defines the Test case without an override. TaskResults.fs reads testing_summary.json, so that filename is valid. The defect is the plural Tests directory copied from the upstream QuickStart typo.
findings.requested_change: Change Tests to Test in the api-testing.md result path; retain testing_summary.json.
findings.resolution: Guide now uses singular Test/RestlerResults and retains the valid testing_summary.json filename.

findings.summary: Captured Windows Schemathesis output needs an explicit UTF-8 setting.
findings.evidence: Both independent reruns of the retained Schemathesis.exe command with captured stdout exited 2 before loading the schema. Python used cp1252 for the pipe and raised UnicodeEncodeError while printing the header; --no-color did not avoid Unicode output.
findings.requested_change: Use a scoped child-process UTF-8 output setting and record it. Schemathesis 4.33.1 does not support python -m schemathesis. Keep console-output failure distinct from service findings.
findings.resolution: New run_schemathesis.py wrapper sets UTF-8 only in the child environment, captures stdout/stderr/JUnit and records the actual invocation. Independent faulty/fixed runs return1/0. Existing output is preserved on repeat invocation. Controlled timeout preserves partial stdout/stderr and returns2.

findings.summary: Later coverage export/gate commands do not select the installed virtual environment.
findings.evidence: The guide installs coverage only in .venv and does not activate it. Initial commands select .venv/Scripts/python.exe explicitly, but later JSON export and --fail-under examples use bare coverage.
findings.requested_change: Use the same virtual-environment interpreter with -m coverage in the later actionable commands.
findings.resolution: Both later coverage JSON and threshold examples select the same .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m coverage interpreter as installation and collection.

findings.summary: Readiness connection exceptions can be swallowed by boofuzz, allowing a failed reset to be recorded as completed.
findings.evidence: In boofuzz 0.4.2 CallbackMonitor.restart_target, ordinary exceptions are logged/discarded while BoofuzzRestartFailedError is rethrown. A controlled TimeoutError from the HEALTH roundtrip was logged but the harness ran both mutations and returned 1/completed-findings, rather than documented setup failure/2.
findings.requested_change: Convert readiness roundtrip OSError/timeout failures into BoofuzzRestartFailedError. Preserve the cause, cover this case with a focused regression, and refresh executed records after rerunning.
findings.resolution: Readiness OSError is now wrapped in BoofuzzRestartFailedError with its cause. The new real-boofuzz timeout regression and two existing server tests pass. Independent normal faulty/fixed runs return1/0 with the same two observations, and retained script/requirements hashes match.

checked_requirements.evidence: Pinned coverage runs reproduced the retained statement/branch reports: line9 and branch3->5 missing in the partial suite, full coverage for reach-only and asserted suites. Test success and threshold status differ. All actionable coverage commands now select the isolated interpreter.

Corrected Jest discovery runs only one intended suite. Refreshed mutation reports show five killed/one boundary survivor versus six killed. State definitions and denominator match primary docs; source/input mutation and assertion-strength distinctions are explicit.

Independent k6 runs reproduced40 iterations/exit0,40 iterations with failed latency threshold/exit99, and zero iterations after failed setup/exit107. Tutorial workload, checks, threshold and completion requirements are explicit.

HTTP lifecycle/reset/schema/known replay tests pass. The scoped UTF-8 wrapper reproduces Schemathesis finding/clean outcomes while retaining artifacts; RESTler remains illustrative with corrected Test log directory. Separate boofuzz fixture supplies two finite mutations, response validation, readiness handling and explicit stop/reset scope, with executed faulty/fixed evidence.

Pinned RTAMT environment metadata confirms Python>=3.8,<3.13 and parser4.7. Independent execution returns [0,-5.0] and [0,1.0]. Original script/requirements digests match, prior parser-failure history remains distinct, and documentation-review date is not relabeled as execution proof.

tests.name: HTTP fixture tests
tests.result: 4 passed; covers known failure/correction, resource lifecycle/reset, invalid inputs and live schema.

tests.name: Initial Jest baselines
tests.result: Both commands exited 0, but discovered stale sandbox test copies; see MR-01.

tests.name: Coverage three-suite reproduction
tests.result: All suites exit 0; partial leaves line 9 and branch 3->5 missing, reach and contract report full statement/branch coverage. Coverage threshold exits partial=2 and reach=0.

tests.name: k6 completed/threshold/setup reproduction
tests.result: Expected exits 0/99/107 and iterations 40/40/0; setup-failed summary thresholds appear okay despite zero iterations, correctly rejected by process status and documented completion requirements.

tests.name: Initial captured Schemathesis reproduction
tests.result: Both modes fail before analysis with stdout UnicodeEncodeError; see MR-03.

tests.name: Schemathesis child UTF-8 workaround
tests.result: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 in the child environment reproduces expected faulty exit 1/ST101 and fixed exit 0/3 operations/6 generated cases. This does not modify global shell or interpreter settings.

tests.name: Corrected Jest baseline recheck
tests.result: Both commands now discover exactly one suite; weak has 1 test, strong has 2. No naming-collision warning or stale-sandbox tests.

tests.name: Protocol target tests
tests.result: 2 passed; faulty/corrected responses, surviving health, new-connection behavior and rejection checked.

tests.name: Protocol readiness timeout failure test
tests.result: Controlled TimeoutError in HEALTH roundtrip is swallowed by the upstream callback layer; harness incorrectly returns completed-findings/1. See MR-05.

tests.name: Schemathesis wrapper completed-run and overwrite tests
tests.result: Independent faulty wrapper exit1, fixed exit0, exact4.33.1 and scoped UTF-8 recorded; JUnit exists for both. Repeating each invocation exits2 and preserves all previous artifact hashes.

tests.name: Schemathesis wrapper controlled timeout
tests.result: TimeoutExpired test double preserves exact partial stdout/stderr, records unknown child exit plus incomplete error, and wrapper exits2.

tests.name: Refreshed mutation and HTTP evidence hashes
tests.result: All current raw input/configuration/runner hashes match refreshed run records. Mutation JSON still shows expected5+1/6 outcomes.

tests.name: Final protocol regression suite
tests.result: 3 passed, including actual-boofuzz controlled readiness TimeoutError returning failed/2.

tests.name: Independent final boofuzz faulty/fixed runs
tests.result: Faulty exits1/completed-findings with empty TRIGGER reply and passing world reply. Fixed exits0/completed-no-findings with both replies exact. Each run writes SQLite evidence. Current target/harness/requirements hashes equal retained records. Every ephemeral server was stopped afterward.

source_checks.scope: Statement/branch opportunities, partial branch semantics, and source reports.
Killed, survived, uncovered, timeout, runtime/compile error, ignored, pending and exact score denominator.
Pinned core release and Node.js >=20 prerequisite.
Checks alone do not set failing test status; thresholds are separate.
Explicit threshold criteria, percentile units, tagged metric selection and failure status.
Quickstart options, generated Compile files, server overrides and request-sending test mode.
Supported response-to-path parameter producer/consumer links using operationId.
Fuzz invocation, hours budget, bug buckets and replay.
Driver task working directory is args.task.ToString(); maximum fuzz duration uses hours.
Test union case yields singular Test task directory.
testing_summary.json is an emitted/consumed report filename.

limitations: This review covers the listed additions and narrow scopes, not every historical profile claim.
No RESTler execution, full build, browser validation, hosted CI or style sweep was performed by this reviewer.
Stryker mutation reports were inspected after coordinator reruns. The independent reviewer reran Jest baselines but not Stryker itself.
Timeout/readiness error cases use controlled faults and are labeled as such; they are not observed failures of the normal fixture.
Executed results use existing pinned local environments and independent loopback instances. They do not establish production capacity, exhaustive defect coverage, or general platform compatibility.
